title: Type-safe HTML templating in Zig
summary: This article explores implementing type-safe HTML templating in Zig by leveraging the language's powerful comptime (compile-time execution) features. It demonstrates how to create HTML templates with compile-time validation, catching errors before runtime and providing better developer experience for web development.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of type safety in traditional HTML templating systems where template errors only surface at runtime.
why_valuable: Brings compile-time guarantees to HTML templating, eliminating entire classes of runtime errors and making web development more reliable in Zig.
